geological_mapping.description: The hard, erosion-resistant ferriferous sand ledge jutting out over the tidal channels.
Discontinuous nodular bands of intense orange iron carbonate lining the intertidal mud layers.
Heavy, dark iron-bearing silt sheets forming the floor of the ancient coastal delta basin.

background_environment.lighting: Warm, direct cinematic light catching the metallic orange and brown rust highlights on the ironstone faces without losing depth in the dark gray channels.
